output_list.reason: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The initialSupply and mintedAmount are added without checking if the total supply exceeds the maximum value a uint256 can store, causing a buy function to be frozen.
The transfer function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if _value is large enough, causing buy function to be frozen.
The transferFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The balanceOf[_to] += _value; can overflow if _value is large enough, causing buy function to be frozen.
The approve function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The totalSupply += _value; can overflow if _value is large enough, causing buy function to be frozen.
The Typo Constructor function has a typo in it, causing it to be non-existent in the contract, allowing attackers to exploit it.
